source_inputs: Pinned pages/page_20/runes.txt, current LP2-03 (217 GP29 runes), and the same commit's relocated data/corpora/deor_poem.txt. Source BASE expects both under tools/, so replay in an isolated temporary directory with source bytes unmodified and paths staged at their source-requested locations. Check each Git blob and byte hash.
source_scope: Source partitions by prime ZERO-BASED rune ordinal, keeps the nonprime-position sequence, picks its first Caesar shift with maximal normalized GP29 IoC, then runs the entire literal route list: prime-position extraction, reverse, 17 column widths, 8 diagonal widths, 7 padded spiral widths, GP-value sort, all starts of 6 fixed-step k values, Fibonacci positions, 4 keyword column orders, and Deor-character-key sort. Also report its separate prime-INDEX-value split/29 Caesar shifts without conflating the two partitions.
source_screen: Preserve literal source Runeglish transliteration and its branch-specific printed English-trigram sets. Columns/diagonals/spirals enter results only when their trigram count exceeds 5; fixed-step extractions enter only above 3; other routes always enter. Its final sort by formatted-info string length is not an English rank. No source rule licenses a plaintext verdict.
amended_diagnostic: Separately count each route's source-style trigrams and the maximum across every executed source route, retaining branch-specific scores and variable output lengths. Repeat the complete Caesar-selection, split, and route sweep on 199 seeded full-page rune shuffles (seed 20261023), preserving length/rune frequencies; compare the manuscript maximum and source-screen retained-route counts with whole-search controls. This is post-source and descriptive, not an historical source verdict or a cipher null.
controls: Before manuscript scoring, check the 217-rune source input mapping and Deor bytes, prove Caesar and complete-permutation IoC invariance algebraically and on synthetic values, source-parity-test every route on a synthetic page using unmodified staged script, and plant a known text through an invertible column route to verify recovery and a >5-trigram hit. Non-invertible extraction/zero-padded spiral routes are classified, not claimed to preserve all data. Independent checker reconstructs every saved selected route and one whole shuffled search.
overlap_and_limits: The existing wulfic-deor-interlocking-streams record tests a PRIME-RUNE-INDEX-VALUE split (65/152), not this prime-POSITION split (47/170). The published keyed transposition cohort tests other pages/keywords. This fixed source script is one grouped search, not a new idea per route width. Its title's 646-rune premise is false for pinned page_20; using current LP2-20 would be a different target. No claim against arbitrary transposition, other layouts or languages.
